phase.title: Lite Combined Phases 2-5 - Manual and Specialist Review

required: Current graph, obligation ledger and invalidation state
conditional: Specialist methods for TRIGGERED or UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE domains
Standards proof for an explicit material conformance claim
Formal proof only when necessary to resolve a material property or candidate

steps.instruction: Perform one principal source-first semantic traversal using the accepted Source Intelligence map only for orientation. Evaluate implementation behavior while simultaneously recording all applicable EVM, privilege and triggered-domain observations at each source anchor; do not run separate full-source passes per lens.

During that same principal traversal, verify every material privilege path and apply each TRIGGERED or UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE specialist method at the relevant source anchors. Reopen raw source only for a targeted unresolved question or contradiction; do not reclassify unchanged domains.

Represent each material observation as a candidate, evidence-backed non-issue or typed limitation; create Lite 6-7 validation obligations and continue to Phase 5 without a separate report or duplicate seal.

sealingCriteria: Every in-scope contract and material reachable function is covered
Every activated material domain has evidence or a typed blocker
Every material observation has a traceable disposition
The principal manual review used one multi-lens semantic source traversal; any repeated source reading is bounded to documented unresolved anchors rather than whole-contract lens-by-lens rereads.

recoveryRoutes.route: Classify invalidation and rebind affected evidence
